title: Clearance games at BAE, 2015-2018

tellings.quote: the problem is is when I was at BAE between 2015 and 2018 they were playing this game.

plain: A man named Dylan Borland says that while he worked at BAE Systems, a large defence contractor, from 2015 to 2018, people there were "playing this game" with security clearances, meaning the permissions that decide who can see secret work. Borland tells it from his own time there, as part of his larger story about being kept from information he thinks he should have had.
